name: Amazon EC2 Spot Instances Pricing
notes: AWS states Spot is 'a discount of up to 90% off compared to On-Demand' and that prices 'adjust gradually based on long-term trends'. CAVEAT on using this as a price source: the per-instance-type Spot table on this page is rendered client-side from the describe-spot-price-history API and did not appear in the extracted HTML, and the spot-price.s3.amazonaws.com/spotprice.js feed returned HTTP 403. So no concrete spot rate for p5/g6/etc is recorded from this page - the discount ceiling is recorded, not a rate.
